contract_answer.question: Across NA-E032..NA-E034, does the fixed-b N1 degradation-law loss retain acceptable MAPE, reduce held-out fixed-b law-fit error, and pass gradient balance on every split?
contract_answer.conclusion: Raw selected-checkpoint predictions confirm split-2021 MAPE 0.076681, Acc@15 0.860, and RMSE 18.9438 cycles. Across all three splits N1 reaches MAPE 0.0976 +/- 0.0181, Acc@15 0.793 +/- 0.059, and RMSE 27.0, versus NA-E009-family 0.1087 +/- 0.0085, 0.729 +/- 0.025, and 29.4 and CPMLP 0.1778 +/- 0.0539, 0.499 +/- 0.144, and 41.4. Fixed-b law-fit falls from parent mean 0.0539 to 0.0445 (17.4% recorded reduction) and loss balance passes on every split. The pre-registered 20% law-fit gate was missed; KEEP is therefore based only on A7-NA, a post-hoc user amendment accepting any held-out reduction, and must be reported as post-hoc.
